global_design_rules: No Inter font, Roboto, or Open Sans. Use the defined premium typography.
No purple or teal gradients. Use stark monochrome with a signal accent.
Containers with borders must have generous internal padding (p-6/p-8) to prevent collision.
Hover states must be explicitly styled and tested for accessible contrast.
Include data-testid on all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='login-button').
Use optical alignment and generous negative space (Tailwind p-8 to p-12).

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-bold
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-tight font-semibold

typography.font_setup_instructions: Add Cabinet Grotesk (via Fontshare or local assets) and Manrope (Google Fonts) in index.html or global CSS. Set Manrope as the default sans family in Tailwind config.

surfaces.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 dark:bg-black/60 border border-white/20 dark:border-white/10 shadow-sm
surfaces.modern_cards: bg-surface border border-border rounded-xl shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary_hover rounded-lg px-6 py-2.5 font-medium transition-colors shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-surface border border-border text-text_primary hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg px-6 py-2.5 font-medium transition-colors
buttons.ghost: text-text_secondary hover:text-text_primary hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 transition-colors

components.inputs: bg-surface border border-border rounded-lg px-4 py-2.5 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 focus:border-primary outline-none text-text_primary placeholder:text-text_secondary/50
components.table_header: text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-text_secondary font-semibold border-b border-border p-4
components.badge: px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border

layout_patterns.sidebar: w-64 flex-shrink-0 border-r border-border bg-surface flex flex-col transition-all duration-300
layout_patterns.header: h-16 border-b border-border bg-surface/80 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-between px-6 z-10

landing_page.strategy: Marketing mode. High visual impact. Use the 'Swiss Grid' and overlapping elements.
landing_page.hero: H1 large (text-6xl), text left-aligned, prominent primary CTA + secondary 'View Demo' ghost button. Abstract geometric background in subtle opacity.
landing_page.features: Bento grid layout (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12) with varying card spans. Use generous padding.

login_register.strategy: Minimalist centered card layout. Glassmorphism effect over a very subtle geometric background. Strict 1px borders.
login_register.components: Shadcn/UI heavily customized inputs and forms. Focus states must pop.

platform_admin_dashboard.strategy: Control Room Grid (Dense). Top-left 'North Star' metrics (Total Tenants, MRR).
platform_admin_dashboard.layout: Data tables for pending approvals. Top-row KPI cards.

business_dashboard.strategy: Focus on Sales Trend (Recharts area chart) and Outlet Health Score.
business_dashboard.layout: KPI strip (4 columns) -> Main Chart (col-span-3) + Activity Feed (col-span-1) -> Tables below.

outlet_manager_dashboard.strategy: Action-oriented. Quick access to Inventory Alerts and Expense Approvals.

pos_billing_screen.strategy: Functional minimalism. High contrast, large tap targets, keyboard shortcut hints visible.
pos_billing_screen.layout: Left 65%: Product grid (or barcode input focus) + Category filters. Right 35%: Cart, totals, tax breakdown, massive 'Pay' button.

hero_background_dark.description: Abstract geometric technology background for dark mode hero/login sections.

hero_background_light.description: Clean light geometric background for light mode hero/login sections.

modern_retail_store.description: Modern retail store interior for landing page testimonials or feature sections.

retail_clothing_display.description: Retail display for e-commerce or multi-outlet feature sections.

animation_and_motion.hover: Subtle translate-y (-1px) and shadow increase on cards. Color fade on buttons.
animation_and_motion.page_transitions: Fade-in and slight slide-up (10px) using Framer Motion.
animation_and_motion.drawer_mobile: Slide-up from bottom with backdrop blur.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color tokens for Tailwind. Map them in tailwind.config.js.
Do NOT use 'Inter'. Add 'Cabinet Grotesk' and 'Manrope'.
Ensure all buttons, inputs, and links have 'data-testid' attributes (e.g. data-testid='pos-pay-button').
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for Landing Page complex layouts, use customized Shadcn/UI for Dashboard/App elements.
Never use empty white/black backgrounds without a subtle tint or border structure.
Make POS screen mobile/tablet responsive, adapting right panel to a bottom sheet or drawer on small screens.
